author: bardic-inspiration
name: Lizardfolk Chieftain
summary: A massive lizardfolk leader who fights with trident and teeth and roars the tribe into a frenzy.
description: A chieftain has beaten every challenger, and the tribe is careful about how it phrases the next one. They are a better leader than their size suggests, with a long memory and a longer patience.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: The chieftain can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chieftain makes three attacks, using Trident once, Bite once, and Trident or Bite once more.

actions.name: Savage Roar

save.targets: each creature of the chieftain's choice within 20 feet of it that can hear it

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the end of the chieftain's next turn.
